messages:
Nora: Quick kickoff for HarborMesh x Redwood partner playbook. Scope: 45m webinar + integration how-to + marketplace listing + short benchmark note. Target date: Sept 9 10:00am PT. Main narrative: seamless multiregion inference with predictable unit cost.

Ethan: Prefer 9:00am PT to catch EMEA too. Audience = infra/platform engineers and platform PMs. Emphasize reproducibility and minimal config changes.

Priya: Partner will share a sanitized perf diff and an architecture SVG. Legal wants percent-only claims and a short disclosure line. Marco, can you own data redaction?

Marco: Yep. I'll take the CSV and produce percent delta charts. Will upload to gdrive/partners/harbormesh/benchmarks_redacted.csv by Thu. If legal pushes back we'll use relative bars only.

Nora: Assets we need from partner: SVG logo, 2 screenshots, 50-word tagline, 150-word marketplace blurb, and speaker headshot. Deadline Fri COB.

Ethan: Webinar agenda: 5m intros, 20m demo (HarborMesh plug-in + multiregion routing), 10m benchmark walkthrough, 10m live Q&A. Keep slides under 10.

Priya: Tracking: registration -> HubSpot form. Route to SFDC queue "Partners/HarborMesh" and tag leads with `utm_campaign=hm-rw-sept9` and `partner=harbormesh`. Form fields: email, company, role, cloud_region (optional), consent.

OpsBot: Form created: https://forms.redwood/hm-rw-sept9. Recording auto-upload set to gdrive/marketing/partners/harbormesh-0909.

Nora: Use the exact UTM string in all partner copy: `?utm_source=harbormesh&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=hm-rw-sept9`. Copy team: please paste exactly.

Marco: Draft reproducibility snippet for the blog (short) 
```bash
# reproduce small-run
python bench.py --model redwood/opt-quant --region us-west1 --batch 4 --tokens 5000
# expect: ~Z tokens/s and ~W ms p95 relative to baseline
```
Will include in the repo with a small dockerfile.

Priya: SFDC routing rule: if email domain matches @harbormesh.io assign to Harbor AE, else to PartnerOps. Also add source=partner_marketplace and campaign=hm-rw-sept9.

Ethan: Promotion plan: 2 joint social posts, 1 co-authored how-to on marketplace, 1 long-form benchmark blog. Email sends: Redwood dev list (8k) + HarborMesh list (4k). Follow-up emails at +24h and +5 days with repo links.

Nora: Creative: DesignBot, can you generate hero mockup 1200x600 and a screenshot 560x315? We'll need an alternate landscape and headshot slot.

DesignBot: Mockups queued. Please upload speaker headshots to #design-uploads by Thu.

Marco: Legal redaction caveat: partner asked that any mention of instance types be generalized. We'll say "standard GPU fleet" instead of exact SKU. Nora, ok to use that in copy?

Nora: That's fine. We'll keep the hero copy technical but not SKU-level. Example hero line: "Deploy multiregion inference with one config and predictable unit economics."

Priya: Assignments recap: Marco -> redacted CSV + charts (Thu), Design -> hero + screenshots (Thu), Ethan -> slides + runbook (Fri), Priya -> HubSpot + SFDC routing (Wed), Nora -> blog draft + landing copy (Mon). Rehearsal: Sept 7 9:00am PT.

Ethan: Can we also surface a small checklist for partner ops: speaker bios, CNAMES, and co-brand approval? I'll add to the partner deck.

Marco: Uploaded redacted CSV to gdrive/partners/harbormesh/benchmarks_redacted.csv. Link in DM.

Nora: Thanks all. I'll post the master checklist here and tag owners. If partner offers a customer case study we can slot it into the follow-up email. :sparkles:

Priya: Noted. Will confirm SFDC mapping once HubSpot form is live.

Ethan: Works for me. :thumbsup:
